name: rift-frontline
description: RIFT FRONTLINE — a browser-based 5v5 FPS-MOBA prototype.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @rift/web" "npm run dev -w @rift/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rift/shared && npm run build -w @rift/server && npm run build -w @rift/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rift/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rift/server && npm run typecheck -w @rift/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rift/shared && npm run test -w @rift/server
